combat.offer: BUBBA: HOLD ON, DARLIN'. BEFORE YOU SWING AT ANYTHIN', DO YOU WANT ME TA WALK YOU THROUGH DA BUTTONS?
normal: BUBBA: ONE ACTION EACH PER ROUND, IN ORDER OF SPEED. PICK IT OFF DA LIST AN' PRESS [CONTINUE]!
BUBBA: ATTACK SWINGS WHATEVER YOU IZ HOLDIN' AT WHOEVER YOU POINT IT AT. IT NEVER GREYS OUT: IT IZ DA ONE THING YOU IZ NEVER LEFT WITHOUT!
BUBBA: DEFENSE BRACES YOU AN' CUTS WHAT LANDS ON YOU FOR DA ROUND. CARRYIN' A GUN, DAT ROW IZ RELOAD INSTEAD: IT FILLS DA MAGAZINE AN' COVERS YOU ALL DA SAME!
BUBBA: SKILLS IZ DA LOADOUT YOU PACKED, EACH ROW PRICED IN MP OR AP. ACTIONS IZ DA PLAIN KIT YOU CARRY WHATEVER YOU FORGET, AN' FOUR THINGS A BODY DOES BESIDES!
BUBBA: UNDER ACTIONS, AIM NAMES A LIMB BEFORE DA SWING AN' COSTS YOU NO TURN, AN' WRESTLE TAKES HOLD OF DA THING WIT YA BARE HANDS!
BUBBA: TALK IZ UNDER DERE TOO, AN' SOME OF DEM DO LISTEN. ITEM IZ DA BACKPACK, AN' THROW, BESIDE TALK, IZ DA SAME BAG HURLED AT SOMEBODY'S HEAD!
BUBBA: RUN ALWAYS WORKS, DARLIN'. NO SHAME IN IT EITHER: A CORPSE LEARNS NOTHIN'!
map: BUBBA: DIS ONE PLAYS OUT WHERE WE IZ STANDIN', SO DA MAP IZ DA ARENA. STILL ONE ACTION EACH PER ROUND, IN ORDER OF SPEED!
BUBBA: MOVE WALKS YOU ACROSS DA TILES BEFORE YOU ACT, ONCE PER ROUND, AS FAR AS YA LEGS AN' YA DEX CARRY YOU!
BUBBA: ATTACK ONLY REACHES AS FAR AS DA RANGE WRITTEN ON ITS ROW, SO COUNT DA TILES BETWEEN YOU AN' IT BEFORE YOU SWING!
BUBBA: SKILLS, ACTIONS, AIM, WRESTLE, TALK, DA BACKPACK AN' THROW ALL STAND AS DEY OWN ROWS OUT HERE, ONLY POINTED AT A TILE!
BUBBA: DA CURSOR IZ HOW YOU NAME DAT TILE: STEP IT ONTO WHAT YOU WANT AN' PRESS [CONTINUE]!
BUBBA: RUN WALKS DA WHOLE PARTY OUT, UNLESS SOMETHIN' HAB HOLD OF US!
combat.rearm: BUBBA: NO PROBLEM DARLIN', ME IZ NO MAGIC EXPERT BUT ME CAN RETEACH YOU HOW TA SHOOT YA GUN! YOU NEED TA FIGURE OUT DA REST YOURSELF
